一路上清玉三人是彻底被时笙给震撼到了，除了那很奇怪能爆炸的紫色小球，她还有一把铁剑。

那铁剑砍起丧尸来就跟砍萝卜似的。

震撼着震撼着也就震撼习惯了。

唯一让他们不解的就是那个少年，他几乎什么都不做，吃东西的时候也是一副嫌弃的表情，好像他吃的不是珍贵的食物，而是令人作呕的恶心东西。

每次看到他那个表情，另外三人就有种打他的冲动。

在末世食物是最珍贵的，有多少人被饿死，有多少人因为食物而杀人，失去良知，人性。

但是又发现他的智商似乎不高，他们只得按耐下这个冲动。

好在他们同路的时间没有多长，B市离他们并不远，大约走了三天，他们就看到了B市安全区的大门。

此时已经离是末世第56天，安全区的管理早就有了一套明确的体系。

“你们是离开，还是跟着我？”

时笙一边让白虎装东西，一边问后座的三人。

这几天她观察过了，这三人确实不错，就算看到她有不少食物，他们除了有些垂涎外，倒没有生出任何的歪念。

不过是不是留下来，还得看他们自己的选择。

“顾小姐是什么意思？”清玉听到时笙问那句话的时候，心中狂跳起来。

“我需要人帮我做事，你们愿意留下来，就是自己人，也许以后……”时笙顿了下，没有在说下去。

她看了千黎一眼，千黎回头对着时笙咧了咧嘴，“饿……”

时笙：“……”

饿你大爷啊！你大爷的除了吃，还有别的技能吗？

清玉和剩下的两人交流了一会儿，都表示愿意留下来，这几天的相处，他们是打心眼里佩服她的。

一个小姑娘，遇事比他们还冷静。

更何况他们本就是她救的，就算报答救命之恩，他们也不会拒绝。

“老大，既然是自己人，那你能不能告诉我，你那把剑到底是什么剑？”林风立即改了口，而且还很不要脸的问了他一直想问的问题。

说那把铁剑削铁如泥都不为过。

“正义之剑。”时笙一脸严肃的道，“拯救世界就靠它了！”

Along the way, Qingyu and the others were completely shocked by Shi Sheng. In addition to the strange exploding purple ball, she also had an iron sword.

The iron sword chopped up zombies like a carrot.

Shocked, shocked, I got used to being shocked.

The only thing that puzzled them was the boy. He did almost nothing and looked disgusted when eating, as if what he was eating was not precious food, but disgusting disgusting things.

Every time they saw that expression on his face, the other three people had the urge to hit him.

In the last days, food is the most precious thing. How many people have starved to death, how many people have killed people because of food, and have lost their conscience and humanity.

But they found that his IQ seemed to be low, so they had no choice but to resist the urge.

Fortunately, they had not been on the same road for long. City B was not far from them. After walking for about three days, they saw the gate of the safety zone of City B.

It is already the 56th day of the end of the world, and the management of the safe zone has already had a clear system.

"Are you leaving or following me?"

Shi Sheng asked Bai Hu to load things while asking the three people in the back seat.

She had observed it over the past few days and found that these three people were really good. Even if they saw that she had a lot of food, they did not have any wrong thoughts except for being a little coveted.

But whether to stay or not depends on their own choice.

"What does Miss Gu mean?" Qingyu's heart jumped wildly when she heard what Shi Sheng asked.

"I need people to help me with things. If you are willing to stay, you are one of my own. Maybe in the future..." Shi Sheng paused and stopped talking.

She glanced at Qian Li, who turned back to Shi Sheng and grinned, "Hungry..."

Shi Sheng: "..."

I'm hungry, uncle!Besides eating, does your uncle have any other skills?

Qingyu communicated with the remaining two people for a while, and both expressed their willingness to stay. After spending the past few days together, they admired her from the bottom of their hearts.

A little girl who is calmer than them in trouble.

What's more, she saved them, so even if she repays her for saving her life, they won't refuse.

"Boss, since you are one of our own, can you tell me what kind of sword you have?" Lin Feng immediately changed his mind and shamelessly asked the question he had always wanted to ask.

It is no exaggeration to say that the iron sword cuts through iron like clay.

"The sword of justice." Shi Sheng said with a serious face, "It depends on it to save the world!"
